createDescription: Describe it for AI, or write, upload or import it yourself.
importHint: Paste a public repository link. We find every skill in its folders.
uploadHint: The upload has more than one SKILL.md. Each one becomes its own skill.
discardBody: This skill has changes that are not saved. They will be lost.
discardNewBody: This skill is not created yet. What you wrote will be lost.
saveFailed: The skill was not saved. Try again.
invalid: Check the name, the description and the instructions.
saveOwnBody: This skill comes from {{repository}}. After you save, it keeps your version and stops getting updates from GitHub.
detachNotice: You are changing a skill that comes from GitHub. After you save, it keeps your version and stops getting updates from {{repository}}.
archivedNotice: This skill is archived. Agents do not use it, and you cannot edit it.
builtinNotice: Agenta maintains this skill. You can read it, but you cannot edit it.
duplicate: You already have another skill called “{{name}}”.
duplicateNew: You already have a skill called “{{name}}”. Creating this one makes a second copy.
loadFailed: We could not load this skill.
archiveBody: Agents can no longer use it. Its name stays reserved, and you can restore it later.
archiveUsedBody_one: {{count}} agent uses this skill: {{agents}}. Its runs fail to load the skill until you restore it or remove it from the agent.
archiveUsedBody_other: {{count}} agents use this skill: {{agents}}. Their runs fail to load the skill until you restore it or remove it from the agents.
saveFirst: Save or discard your changes first.
createDescriptionManual: Write it, upload it, or import it from GitHub.
